question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**launched**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the government’s initiative to introduce a new tool to support the move towards a cashless society.
 
• The correct verb should indicate the formal introduction or release of the government's own app.
 
• "**Launched**" (प्रारंभ किया) fits well in the context as it means to officially start or introduce something new.
 
• Other options ("**followed**", "**sensed**", "**submitted**") do not match the intended meaning of releasing a new app.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *A cashless India is the first step towards making the dream of digital India a reality. Government is trying to **create__ a cashless environment in the country. Demonetisation appears to be a stepping *__*stone*__ *in that direction. To help facilitate this, government even **__launched__** its own app ‘BHIM’ built for the same purpose. The **(4)___________* *of conducting online financial transactions is probably the biggest motivator to go digital. You will no longer need to carry wads of cash, plastic cards or even queue up for ATM withdrawals. It’s also safer and easier spending option when you are travelling. Making transactions digitally makes it easy to keep track of your finances. The **(5)___________* *are enormous for everyone if you leave out the low-income group, which will face a huge challenge. For the rest of the country, it is constructive and simple. However, the convenience of net-banking, m-banking, card or mobile wallet transactions can make you spend more than your budget.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Followed **(अनुसरण किया): “Followed” means to come after something in sequence, which does not imply the introduction of an app.
 
• **Sensed **(महसूस किया): “Sensed” means to perceive something by a physical sense, which is unrelated to introducing an app.
 
• **Submitted **(प्रस्तुत किया हुआ): “Submitted” means to present something formally for consideration, which does not match the context of releasing an app.
